integrity_notes: The proof supplies explicit exhaustive two-point extension conditions and a three-move game strategy. The recorded Python program recomputes full logical types in small dimensions. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary pure-adjacency first-order logic only, quantifier rank at most three; dimensions at least one; smallest representative sharp only within the halved-cube family. A finite verifier supplements rather than replaces the all-dimensional proof. Unindexed historical equivalence remains a possible literature risk.
title: Seven rank-three theories of halved cubes and a sharp 64-vertex representative
